children: New Delhi, Sept. 30 -- Indian stock market investors are likely to track several companies on Thursday, October 01, following key business developments, fundraising plans, order wins, project updates, regulatory notices and strategic initiatives.

Jio Financial Services, NCC, Highway Infrastructure, Interarch Building Solutions and ideaForge Technology is among the stocks likely to remain in focus. Modulex Construction, Apollo Tyres, IRFC, Blue Dart Express and Infosys may also attract attention following their latest corporate announcements.
Jio Financial Services: Jio Financial Services: The company and Allianz Europe B.V. have each invested Rs.320.05 crore in Jio Allianz General Insurance, their 50:50 joint venture.
Both partners subscribed to and were allotted 32,00,50,000 equity shares of Rs.10 each for cash at par through a rights issue. JV will utilise the amount to fund its business operations.

NCC: The company announced that it has secured two additional orders worth Rs.500.22 crore, excluding GST, during September 2026. Of the total, Rs.224.74 crore is related to the Buildings Division and Rs.275.48 crore to the Transportation Division.
Highway Infrastructure: The company said it has entered into an Rs.220.66 crore contract with UPEIDA for toll plaza operations on the Gorakhpur Link Expressway.

Interarch Building Solutions: The company announced that it has secured an Rs.89 crore order for a pre-engineered steel structure for a data center. The customer's name was not disclosed due to confidentiality obligations.
ideaForge Technology: The company said it has secured multiple orders worth Rs.23.62 crore from domestic civil customers for the supply of UAVs, accessories and training.
Modulex Construction: The company informed investors that it had received an Rs.14.72 crore order for a modular building project.
Apollo Tyres: The company said its Committee of Directors has allotted NCDs worth Rs.500 crore through a private placement.
IRFC: The company disclosed that it has received a Rs.397 crore GST show-cause notice from the Bihar tax authorities.
Blue Dart Express: The company announced a 9%-12% price increase across its domestic portfolio, effective January 1, 2027, depending on the product and customer shipping profile.

Infosys: The company announced that it has extended its strategic partnership with ABN AMRO to accelerate the Dutch bank's AI-driven transformation, including application development, testing and support services.
